messages.subject: Planned maintenance: document management system Saturday 8 Nov
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The DMS and remote desktop will be unavailable this Saturday 8 November from 07:00 to 13:00 for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please save and check in any open documents before Friday evening. Email will be unaffected.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk
